_comment: Template for the Zenodo record that hosts the raw corpus (ijf-datasets/).
Paste these values into the Zenodo upload form, or POST them to the
Zenodo REST API as the 'metadata' object. Fill in the TODOs before
publishing. See README.md > Publishing the data to Zenodo.

metadata.title: IJF Link Discovery: Canadian donations, appointments, lobbying, and procurement corpus
metadata.description: Raw CSV corpus underpinning the IJF link-discovery experiments: political donations, government appointments, lobbying registrations, procurement records, and charity metadata for Canadian federal and provincial jurisdictions. 15 tables, approximately 6 GB uncompressed. The cleaned layer and the notebook samples are not distributed here; they are reproducible from this raw corpus using pipeline/clean_datasets.py and scripts/make_samples.py in the accompanying code repository. SHA-256 checksums for every file are published as checksums.sha256 in that repository.
metadata.license: TODO: confirm redistribution terms of each source before choosing (e.g. cc-by-4.0)
metadata.notes: Tables: apt.csv (appointments), cha_meta.csv (charity metadata), don_mv.csv (donations), lob_firm.csv, lob_lobbyist.csv, lob_meta.csv, lob_org.csv, lob_rd_mv.csv, lob_target.csv (lobbying), pro_award.csv, pro_contact.csv, pro_supplier.csv, pro_tender.csv (procurement), rep_meta.csv, rep_target.csv (reporting).
